title: Anthropic to add US voting information to Claude before midterms
source_used: Anthropic's own announcement (anthropic.com/news/2026-us-midterms); Reuters page blocked (HTTP 401)
key_facts: Anthropic published its US midterms election-safeguards update on 14 Oct 2026.
Later this month Claude.ai will draw official voting information from Democracy Works into answers for US users, giving state-specific answers on where to vote or what ID to bring.
Claude will also show up-to-date official results on election night and after.
A TurboVote banner from Democracy Works already appears for voter-registration, polling-place and election-date questions.
Anthropic's analysis of 250,000 US conversations found about 5.75% touch on politics or policy, about 0.51% are specifically about elections or voting, and about 0.01% ask whom to vote for.

Outside testers found Claude reliably refused a single harmful election request but could miss a malicious campaign split into many harmless-looking tasks; Anthropic says it added new classifiers for multi-step misuse.
quote_evidence: Later this month, Claude will start drawing official voting information from Democracy Works into its responses on Claude.ai for users in the US.
Claude will begin showing up-to-date results on election night and in the days that follow.
why_it_matters_hint: Millions of US users asking an AI where and how to vote will get state-specific official answers.
notes: Reuters article blocked; facts read from Anthropic's own post, which Reuters reports. Reuters headline wording not copied.
